question_text: Was the Pacific Blue Cross outage a cyberattack?
answer_text: Unclear so far. Pacific Blue Cross calls it a "cyber incident" that disrupted some systems and says it has contained it, but it has not said what happened, whether anyone got in or whether data was taken.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: Pacific Blue Cross or an official source saying what happened: whether someone got into its systems or the outage had another cause.

question_text: Was Pacific Blue Cross members' personal information stolen?
what_would_settle_it: A statement from Pacific Blue Cross or a privacy regulator saying whether members' personal information was accessed or taken.

question_text: When will Pacific Blue Cross's website and claims be back?
what_would_settle_it: Pacific Blue Cross saying its website and contact centre are back.

question_text: What should Pacific Blue Cross members do about claims in the meantime?
answer_text: Keep claims, receipts and plan requests; Pacific Blue Cross says it will process them once services are restored. Some members have had to pay for prescriptions themselves meanwhile.
label: Confirmed

question_text: Was the Pacific Blue Cross incident ransomware?
what_would_settle_it: Pacific Blue Cross or an official source naming the cause; no credible outlet has reported a ransomware group claiming it.
